5.1.6: faster DihScript game reads

- Fix repeated inventory, position, health, player-flag and menu reads waiting on a separate client-thread task for every call. Simple reads now use detached client-tick snapshots; existing scripts benefit without rewriting their slot loops.
- Add `inventorySnapshot()` for all 36 main inventory slots plus offhand, including item IDs, counts and durability.
- Refresh observations after script actions and GUI/pathing waits. Inventory changes still use live game-thread actions and server-confirmed transactions.
- Fence disconnected snapshots against departing-world captures and isolate mutable results between scripts.
- Bound automatic capture of argument queries to those scripts actually use, avoiding unnecessary background scans.
- Document snapshot timing and the world queries that still require a live lookup.

Validation: 105 script tests passed on Fabric 1.21.11 and 105 on Fabric 26.2. The 100-read regression requires zero additional game-thread calls after capture. This is not a claim of a measured live-client speedup on every system.

Retains all 5.1.5 features and release targets: Fabric 1.21.11 and 26.1.2; Fabric, NeoForge and Forge for 26.2 and 26.3.
